g.text: Frozen validation: every encoder, view, chunk size and adapter
Descriptive means; curves may overlap exactly. Same 144 questions / 16 articles across correlated views/models.
128/256/512 budgets were predeclared; exact frozen-vector replay, no new encoder calls or latency measurement.
